assessments.rationale: Two issues disqualify this candidate. First, at event 19 the user provided 'I found a better deal elsewhere' as the cancellation reason, which is not one of the two policy-mandated reasons ('no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake'). The agent should have prompted the user to select from the acceptable reasons rather than silently mapping it to 'no longer needed'. The policy requires the user to confirm the reason, and the user never explicitly confirmed 'no longer needed'. Second, at event 22 the agent states the gift card balance is 'now $124.00', which is fabricated and unsupported (original $62 + $2,674.40 refund = $2,736.40).
